## 检查 / How it was checked

-

独立审查不是必需的。日常小改动也可以不打开 Pull Request。
An independent reviewer is optional. Small solo changes do not need a pull request.

维护者的 PR 标题和正文采用项目维护交流语言，优先遵循项目声明，其次参考维护者结合项目文档作出的判断。仍无法确定时用简体中文。中文 PR 可按读者需要附简短英文摘要。外部贡献者可用英文或简体中文，全文翻译可选。
Maintainers use the project's maintenance language for the PR title and body. Follow the project's declaration first, then the maintainer's judgment based on project docs. If neither determines a language, use Simplified Chinese. Add a brief English summary to Chinese PRs when it helps readers. External contributors can use English or Simplified Chinese. Full translations are optional.
